author: Sabine Hossenfelder

Subscribe to IEEE Spectrum today for 20% off an annual subscription: https://spectrum.ieee.org/sabine and follow @ieeespectrum to stay ahead in tech and engineering.

Small modular nuclear reactors were supposed to make nuclear power cheaper and faster to build. Governments from the US to the UK are now pouring billions into them. At the same time, one startup after another is going bankrupt. What’s going on? Let’s take a look.
